description: This file defines the CacheStatement class, which extends PDOStatement to add caching capabilities to database query execution within the Goteo project. It manages cache keys, cache timing, and integrates with cache storage to optimize database reads by caching results of SELECT statements. Additionally, it tracks query statistics and supports skipping cache for specific queries.

classes.name: CacheStatement
classes.description: A subclass of PDOStatement that adds query caching functionality, including cache key management, cache timing, and statistics tracking. It overrides execute methods to implement caching logic for SELECT statements and provides additional cache control methods.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes CacheStatement with database handle, cache object, and debug mode, setting relevant properties including whether the query is a SELECT.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Overrides parent execute to delay actual execution for SELECT statements, setting cache keys and timing; for non-SELECT, executes immediately and tracks queries.

methods.name: _execute
methods.description: Delegates execution of the statement with parameters, handling exceptions and timing for non-cached queries.

methods.name: cacheTime
methods.description: Gets or sets the cache duration for the current query.

methods.name: skipCache
methods.description: Marks the current query to skip cache on next execution.

methods.name: _cachedMethod
methods.description: Executes a cache-aware method (like fetch, fetchAll) attempting to retrieve from cache before executing the delegate query.

methods.name: _nonCachedMethod
methods.description: Executes a method directly without cache, delegating to parent.

methods.name: fetchColumn
methods.description: Fetches a single column, utilizing cache if available.

methods.name: fetchObject
methods.description: Fetches an object, utilizing cache if available.

methods.name: fetchAll
methods.description: Fetches all results, utilizing cache if available.

methods.name: fetch
methods.description: Fetches a single row, utilizing cache if available.

methods.name: columnCount
methods.description: Returns column count, utilizing cache if available.

methods.name: nextRowset
methods.description: Advances to next rowset without cache.
